changes.title: TimedDamageOrigins
changes.text: Represent merged fire ownership as the same mixed cause sample on every Burning tick.

changes.title: CellDamageOrigins
changes.text: Carry combined side-neighbour ownership into spread fire and snapshot it for timed damage.

changes.title: Fire
changes.text: Preserve mixed offensive ownership through fire seeding, decay, spread, clearing and saves.

changes.title: Burning
changes.text: Apply merged fire ownership exactly once per original Burning event.

changes.title: Player fire fields
changes.text: Mark Liquid Flame and Fireblast fields with their actual player creator.

changes.title: Chained bombs
changes.text: Let unowned heap-triggered bombs inherit the actual causal explosion or fire owner while saved owners remain unchanged.

changes.title: Damage provenance regressions
changes.text: Retain fire role/mix/spread/save/legacy/clear checks and causal multi-bomb chain checks.

changes.title: Fire and chained-bomb evidence

changes.title: Handoff and ledger
